_note: What our side proposes on the brother's map where his data is silent (MIGRATION_3D §5, §6 M1b). Everything here is in HIS coordinates: metres, origin at the centre, north = -Z. The bake reads his files first and this second; an entry marked scaffold is a placeholder that disappears the day his data names the same thing. Nothing here is a decision about the map — it is what lets every system and test run on his terrain today, and the bake's report says exactly what is still a proposal.
_places_order: zone order (Region.ZONE_ORDER); the bake keeps it
